---
title: "Fishes of Pine Creek"
---

Fish species documented at field-verified sites in the Pine Creek watershed, Allegheny County, PA.

```{r}
#| echo: false
#| warning: false
#| message: false
#| results: asis

library(readxl)
library(htmltools)

fish <- read_excel("data/fishSpecies.xlsx")
names(fish) <- tolower(gsub("[^A-Za-z]", "", names(fish)))

# Find columns flexibly (works with commonName, common_name, Common Name, etc.)
pick <- function(pattern) {
  hit <- grep(pattern, names(fish), value = TRUE)
  if (length(hit) == 0) NA_character_ else hit[1]
}
col_common <- pick("common|^species$|^name$")
col_sci    <- pick("scientific|latin")
col_desc   <- pick("descri")
col_show   <- pick("showonwebsite|show")
col_img    <- pick("image|photo|picture")
col_credit <- pick("credit")

has_val <- function(x) !is.na(x) && nzchar(trimws(as.character(x)))

# Match a photo to a file in images/ even if the spreadsheet entry has a
# different extension, capitalization, or folder, or is blank (falls back to
# the species name, e.g. "Creek Chub" -> creekchub.jpg)
find_img <- function(photo, common) {
  files <- list.files("images")
  keys <- tolower(tools::file_path_sans_ext(files))
  cand <- c(
    if (has_val(photo)) tolower(tools::file_path_sans_ext(basename(trimws(photo)))),
    tolower(gsub("[^A-Za-z]", "", common))
  )
  for (k in cand) {
    j <- match(k, keys)
    if (!is.na(j)) return(file.path("images", files[j]))
  }
  NA_character_
}

if (!is.na(col_show)) {
  fish <- fish[tolower(trimws(as.character(fish[[col_show]]))) == "yes", ]
}

if (nrow(fish) == 0) {
  cat("*Species list coming soon.*")
} else {
  fish <- fish[order(fish[[col_common]]), ]
  cards <- lapply(seq_len(nrow(fish)), function(i) {
    img_path <- find_img(if (!is.na(col_img)) fish[[col_img]][i] else NA,
                         fish[[col_common]][i])
    credit   <- if (!is.na(col_credit)) fish[[col_credit]][i] else NA
    div(class = "fish-card",
        if (has_val(img_path) && file.exists(img_path))
          tags$img(src = img_path, alt = fish[[col_common]][i],
                   style = "width:100%; border-radius:4px; margin-bottom:0.6rem;"),
        if (has_val(img_path) && file.exists(img_path) && has_val(credit))
          div(style = "font-size:0.75rem; color:#777; margin:-0.4rem 0 0.6rem 0;",
              paste("Photo:", credit)),
        h3(fish[[col_common]][i]),
        if (!is.na(col_sci)) div(class = "sci-name", fish[[col_sci]][i]),
        if (!is.na(col_desc)) p(fish[[col_desc]][i]))
  })
  html <- as.character(div(class = "fish-grid", cards))
  # Wrap as a raw HTML block so Quarto doesn't re-interpret the text
  cat("```{=html}\n", html, "\n```\n", sep = "")
}
```
